# zher2k

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Add a complex matrix product to its Hermitian transpose using one-by-one matrices with real entries 2 and 3. The stored result is 12.

## What this example demonstrates

Add a complex matrix product to its Hermitian transpose using one-by-one matrices with real entries 2 and 3. The stored result is 12.
